pr.body:
Production merge `1c715d21d1fd23a87087b74bbb068f4efbe74aa1` was OOM-killed at 2026-10-09 15:54:55 UTC during school switching and NTU globe/photo/life verification, causing 502 responses on the 512 MiB service.

The fix structures workflow rows while reading, avoids deep-copying read-only partner provenance, reads destination bundles/publication history for the requested home school, and permits two large catalogue response builds concurrently. It preserves complete source payloads and independent collector copies. Browser regression also reproduced a lost-click race when `initIcons()` replaced a pressed SVG; unchanged icons now retain their nodes and the app asset version is bumped. The calendar reminder test now uses an explicit Taipei browser date, matching notification semantics across midnight; its assertions remain intact.

Final candidate: `f3e0b666f28d82deaf17ceec701d8f0131ea2b5c`. Full 2,647-case regression is being rerun on this SHA. The preceding complete run is retained with its original mobile navigation and UTC/Taipei calendar failures; both corrected scenarios and two new icon cases passed focused verification. No tests or skip markers were removed.

Memory evidence on the preceding Python fix (`bedc9a03`): three batches of eight parallel CCU dashboard requests reduced local peak RSS/HWM from 586.57 MiB to 338.56 MiB (42.28%); every HTTP request completed. With background cache warming enabled, 360 GETs, 36 school switches and six full NTU globe/photo/life tests passed at 424.57 MiB peak. Full 35-migration PostgREST/Storage, 17 governance groups / 74 RPCs, six-school forum policy and deployed-client compatibility passed. Local process measurements are not production Render metrics; final live stability remains a required gate.

No DB migration is needed. Source datasets, licensed image/vendor assets, migration bytes, dependencies/lock, Actions definitions and OpenAPI are unchanged. Quality stays disabled_manually; no Render, plan, permission, credential or billing settings were changed. After acceptance, merge only the fixed head and verify the exact auto-deployed SHA, low-load six-school/NTU behavior, memory headroom and absence of failure/restart events. A code revert requires no DB reversal but returns to the known OOM-prone version.

[Incident and release notes](https://github.com/blizzard-new/abroad/blob/f3e0b666f28d82deaf17ceec701d8f0131ea2b5c/docs/six-school-memory-2026-10-09.md) · [Raw evidence, failures and current gate](https://github.com/blizzard-new/abroad/tree/artifacts/integration-20261009/docs/integration-20261009).
